headline: Palantine Berm Heaviest Fight; Callahan's Passage Wholly Warden
war_summary: Palantine Berm stays the heaviest file on the desk, its seven posts now standing six Warden to one Colonial after four events in the past two hours and twenty-nine in the day; Leiri Hermanni and Windburn Landing carry most of the traffic. Callahan's Passage has gone wholly Warden, ten posts to none, the last Colonial hold there lost since the previous edition, with fresh filings at Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage. Kuura Strand, fierce at the last filing, has fallen quiet: all six posts Warden and no casualties reported in two hours. Nevish Line stands deadlocked at four posts apiece after nineteen events in a day, and Stlican Shelf has edged to three Warden, five Colonial and one unclaimed, Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost still the busiest names. Weathered Expanse remains the twenty-four-hour leader at thirty-five events but has cooled at the front; its posts hold two Warden to seven Colonial. Mooring County keeps eleven posts to one Colonial, and heavy loss figures continue at Viper Pit and Stonecradle. No victor is declared.
